nom: medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm

avis.texte: Did nothing for my skin. Feels like a giant chapstick that you use on your face. I would not recommend.

avis.titre: I wish I was paid for this review
avis.texte: I work for Ulta so I saw this product being shelved and i LOVE Medicube's pink line. Im 34 i have fine lines, large pores on my nose, between my eyebrows, and a bit on my cheeks. Combination skin AND a lit of volume and elasticity loss from losing weight. I work in the salon, a guest came to us asking for recommendations for volume loss and crepeing under here eyes. She pointed right at me and said "YOU LOOK BEAUTIFUL WHAT DO YOU USE?!" Like. Girl omgosh. Thank you. This. I used this stick halphhazzardly before bed because i almost forgot. Then i used it yesterday before work. And it made such a noticeable difference a stranger clocked it??? Buy it. I especially really really really feel a lot better about my neck skin. Weight loss really had me ready to cry. This stick will be in my kit for as long as they make it 🥹

avis.titre: I'm 38 and it's working for me
avis.texte: I didn't buy it from Ulta, but i will now to avoid shipping! I love this product, ive been using it for two months, twice a day. My biggest issue are my under eyes are sunken in and i have deep smile lines. After two months using this, there IS A NOTICEABLE DIFFERENCE. Consistency is key. I promise. Yes is it a bit greasy feeling, sure but its minimal. I dont wear much face makeup so its a glow (along with my serum and moisturizer) My smile likes are sooo much fuller and not deep. My under eyes are filling out. I frickin love this and ive bought two more. Give it some time, it can work for you!

I bought into the hype and it was so cheap i had to buy it. I too was skeptical and after using it daily for a couple of weeks and didn't see a difference, I stopped using it. Might work for younger people, but not as much for people in their mid thirties.

28 yr old here, hydration and mosturizing under eye helps definitely starting at an early age with skin care helps maintain a youthful appearance. I have dark under eyes sleep definitely helps! this has been a great part of my routine for me been using for about a week and a half and I love it. I dont usually make reviews. But it may not be for everyone but if you're someone who does skin care religiously than this is a great add on. I add it before bed and I add it before starting my day so twice a day. I use it under my eyes my smile lines and lips additionally also wear it under my makeup. Somedays I can see it works great otherdays i just need more sleep and water. Its not an instant thing but if you pay attention and youre someone who has the routine down I recommend.

all this stick might be good for is locking in hydration and providing your under-eye area with milia. using it lightly every so often may give you more moisture retention, but it certainly didnt work for me to help fill in the bags under my eyes, or to "volufill" areas on my face. if you dont like greasy film sitting on your face, this product also wont be for you. id image this product may work a bit more in the way of "filling" you out if youre in your early 20's, but I would still be cautious with overuse. It was easy to apply too much and have it absolutely pill every other skincare product I was using on my face. would not buy again, kinda regretting getting one as I dont need another moisturizing in my makeup bag.

The best way to use volufiline. It takes a few weeks, thats just the nature of the way volufiline works but this gave me my top lip back and no more dark undereyes. I use it 2x daily around my eyes and in my lines and all day long on my lips like chapstick. Its not magic, people.

this is a skip! the hype was all great marketing with influencers saying their skin felt like they had gotten filler. its not hard to have plump and perfect skin when youre in your early 20's. as a mid 30's woman, this was a pass for me, ive been using every day for over a month and see absolutely no difference. the one pro is that its hydrating. save your money and invest it towards something with less incentivized reviews.

I don't understand the negative reviews on this products, unless it was meant for the wrinkle bounce stick, which does absolutely nothing, or they really didn't have any lines to plump to begin with. For me, this balm does wonders making the skina around my mouth and eyes appear fuller and fresher.
I used this product for half a month and it did nothing to my skin. I was skeptical I also don't like how it'd won't absorb into my skin. It just sits on the face. Not a fan.
This product is neither made, Nor distributed by medicube. This is a rip off / fake product. Who lnow what it actually is.

This stuff is amazing!! I have been using it for approximately 3 weeks. It sold out and came back in so this time I ordered two just incase it sells out again. It's true what people say it literally plumps up you skin wherever you put it. I use it everyday morning and night with my skin routine. I noticed my lips and under eyes plump up. My lips actually look like I got filler! I liked this product so much I bought more from the Medicube line and I have been over joyed with all its products that i purchased!! What can I say try it for yourself!

avis.titre: Love the way this feels on my skin
avis.texte: Ive been using this on my undereyes, lips and smile lines at least once a day for a couple weeks. It goes on so smooth and feels really nice. No noticeable difference yet but I love the way it feels. Ill keep buying.

I have been using this product for 3 weeks. I put it on at night, before bed and in the morning after I shower. I rub it in before applying makeup. It does not effect the makeup going on as usual. It is lightweight, not too greasy. I see a slight difference so far, but hoping it will eventually improve the skin under my eyes that is dark and sunken in.

I'm really trying to brighten my eyes and fix a few wrinkles my goodness this is so great! I get complimented so much on how gorgeous my skin is on top of using the other products with this. It has been a life changer. I use it morning and evening.

avis.titre: I will not be buying again
avis.texte: I was hoping this was not a scam since I was buying it from ULTA but this product definitely did not live up to the hype. Will not be buying again.

I have only used it a few times, I apply it overnight and I see a big difference around my eyes. Only put it areas you want to have volume, or you can make your eyes look puffy. I lost a lot of weight, and maybe it is helping because I had fat cells that shrank a lot. So far I like it a lot.
